In this notebook, I will compile T cell correlation data, including pearson correlations+significance, geometric mean of affiliated cell states, nodes/edges in correlation networks, and cell-cell interaction analysis performed through NicheNet into a single Excel file.

# Setup


```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(openxlsx)
library(multinichenetr)

thisseed <- 231103

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29479391/import-multiple-excel-sheets-using-openxlsx
read_all_sheets = function(xlsxFile, ...) {
  sheet_names = getSheetNames(xlsxFile)
  sheet_list = as.list(rep(NA, length(sheet_names)))
  names(sheet_list) = sheet_names
  for (sn in sheet_names) {
    sheet_list[[sn]] = openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile, sheet=sn, ...)
  }
  return(sheet_list)
}
```

# Prepare Data

## Cell State Frequencies

```{r}
CellFreqDF.wide.scored <- read_csv("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_GeometricMeans.csv")
CellFreqDF.wide.scored
```

```{r}
freqs.out <- CellFreqDF.wide.scored %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, TAC:ILC) %>% 
  arrange(biopsy)
  
freqs.out
```

```{r}
geommean.out <- CellFreqDF.wide.scored %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, starts_with("geommean")) %>% 
  rename(Th1_GeomMean = geommean.th1, 
         Th17_GeomMean = geommean.th17, 
         `PD1Hi Tfh_GeomMean` = geommean.tfh) %>% 
  arrange(diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)
  
geommean.out
```

## Network

```{r}
correlation.list.wide <- read_all_sheets("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Pearson_Correlation.xlsx")
correlation.list.wide
```

```{r}
network.nodes <- read_csv("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Correlation_Nodes.csv")
network.nodes
```

```{r}
network.edges <- read_csv("out/correlation/Th1Th17Tfh_Correlation_Edges.csv")
network.edges
```

# Combine Lists

```{r}
correlation.out <- list(
  "Key" = data.frame(),
  "CellState_Frequencies" = freqs.out,
  "Geometric_Means" = geommean.out,
  "Network_Edges" = network.edges,
  "Network_Nodes" = network.nodes
  ) %>% 
  append(correlation.list.wide)
  
correlation.out
```

# NicheNet

```{r}
multinichenet_output <- readRDS("data/nichenet/analysis/multinichenetoutput__ccduc_t0_thtfh_praw.rds")
multinichenet_output %>% names
```

```{r}
prioritization_tables <- multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables
prioritization_tables
```

```{r}
prioritization_tables.thtfh <- prioritization_tables

prioritization_tables.thtfh$group_prioritization_tbl <- prioritization_tables.thtfh$group_prioritization_tbl %>% filter(sender %in% c("Thelper", "Tfh"))
prioritization_tables.thtfh$sample_prioritization_tbl <- prioritization_tables.thtfh$sample_prioritization_tbl %>% filter(sender %in% c("Thelper", "Tfh"))
prioritization_tables.thtfh$group_prioritization_table_source <- prioritization_tables.thtfh$group_prioritization_table_source %>% filter(sender %in% c("Thelper", "Tfh"))

prioritization_tables.thtfh
```

```{r}
top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh <- get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  prioritization_tables.thtfh, 
  top_n = 120, 
  senders_oi = c("Thelper", "Tfh"),
  rank_per_group = FALSE
  )

top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh
```


```{r}
top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh <- prioritization_tables.thtfh$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>% 
  left_join(top_lr_overall.sender.thtfh)
top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$prioritization_score[is.na(top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$prioritization_score)] = 0

top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh
```

```{r}
prioritization_tables.thtfh$ligand_activities_target_de_tbl <- prioritization_tables.thtfh$ligand_activities_target_de_tbl %>% filter(ligand %in% top_lr_overall_prioritized.sender.thtfh$ligand)

prioritization_tables.thtfh
```

```{r}
# write_xlsx trims names to 31 characters anyway
names(prioritization_tables.thtfh) <- c(
  "group_priority",
  "sample_priority",
  "ligand_activities",
  "group_priority_source"
)

names(prioritization_tables.thtfh)
```


# Combine Lists

```{r}
nichenet.out <- prioritization_tables.thtfh
  

nichenet.out
```

# Combine All

```{r}
joint.out <- c(
  correlation.out,
  nichenet.out
)

joint.out
```


```{r}
write_xlsx(joint.out, 
           path = "out/tables/Supplemental Table 6 - T Cell Correlation and Cell-Cell Interaction.xlsx", 
           col_names = TRUE, 
           format_headers = TRUE, 
)
```
